title: Annotatio IV §.I close: Who wrecked the peace molimina? The wicked / common enemy (Matt. 13:28) — stop before §.II
pass_a_gloss: So then to one asking: Who demolished the peace Efforts recounted above, you would not unaptly answer with Christ’s words: that the wicked one and common Enemy did it, Matthew 13:28.
pass_b_english: So to anyone who asks who wrecked the peace attempts recounted above, you may aptly answer with Christ’s words:
the wicked one — our common enemy — did it (Matthew 13:28).
Stop before §. II (internal fountains: pravity of will and error of intellect).
source_text: Ut Proinde quaesituro: Quis molimina Pacis supra recensita demolitus sit, haud ineptè verbis Christi respondeas: πονηρὸν Inimicumque communem id perpetrâsse, Matth. 13, 28.
